{"summary":"The change is scoped as claimed: one pure-constant import, one static rule paragraph, and one reworded reason. The diff and excerpts show no query, auth, event, or schema changes. The copy matches the contract: coverage of 90% or more counts as complete, replayed or skipped ranges add nothing, and orders must be established, not cancelled, and within 7 days of first completion. It also says an order is not the same as paid. The five cards still render \"尚不可計算\". The main risk is a weakened test guard, because the blanket no-percent/no-seconds assertion was replaced by a narrower check on one paragraph shape. Smaller issues are rule wording that may read as aggregate-across-viewers, a now-stale \"口徑就緒\" sentence, and an unqualified \"統計規則\" label.","findings":[{"file":"src/app/(app)/lives/[id]/analytics/page.test.tsx","area":"test-coverage / unavailable-metric guard","severity":"medium","confidence":0.8,"issue":"The unavailable-metric guard was weakened. The section-wide `not.toMatch(/\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:%| 秒)/)` was removed because the new rule copy contains \"90%\". It was replaced by a check that only inspects `

` elements.","evidence":"Removed: `expect(section).not.toMatch(/\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:%| 秒)/);`. Added: metricValues regex over the one value-paragraph class, plus `toContain(\"90\")`. A computed value such as \"85%\" or \"120 秒\" placed in a reason paragraph, badge, or any other element would now pass.","impact":"The test no longer proves that no calculated metric appears anywhere in the section, which is what the requirement to keep the 5 metrics unavailable with and without activity needs. A future regression could leak a number without failing the test.","recommended_fix":"Keep the original blanket assertion and exempt only the approved rule paragraph. For example, strip `

...

` from the section and run `not.toMatch(/\\d+(?:\\.\\d+)?(?:%| 秒)/)` on the remainder. Keep the metricValues equality check as an additional guard.","required_test":"In both `existing activity` and `no activity` cases: after removing the data-metric-rule paragraph, the remaining section has no digit+% or digit+秒 pattern and exactly 5 \"尚不可計算\". Add a negative check that a mutated card such as \"尚不可計算 85%\" or a number in a reason fails the assertion."},{"file":"src/app/(app)/lives/[id]/analytics/page.test.tsx","area":"test-coverage / rule copy","severity":"low","confidence":0.7,"issue":"The rule assertions are loose. `toContain(\"90\")` matches any \"90\" in the section. Nothing asserts the 7-day window, the \"90%\" pairing, or the not-paid disclaimer in context. Because JSX renders `{COMPLETION_PERCENT}%` and the day expression as separate text nodes, string assertions on the full phrase are fragile under renderToString comment separators.","evidence":"Added assertions: `toContain(\"90\")`, `toContain(\"天內成立且未取消的訂單，不等同已付款\")`. There is no assertion for \"7\" or for \"90%\". The constants are interpolated, so changing `POST_COMPLETION_ORDER_WINDOW_MS` to 14 days would still pass.","impact":"A change to the approved 90% or 7-day constants, or removal of the rule paragraph's threshold text, may go unnoticed by the page test.","recommended_fix":"Build the rule sentence as one template string (or a single text node) so the rendered text is contiguous. Assert the full approved sentence, including \"達 90% 才算完看\" and \"首次完看後 7 天內成立且未取消的訂單，不等同已付款\", scoped to the `data-metric-rule=\"approved\"` paragraph.","required_test":"Assert the rule paragraph, selected by data-metric-rule=\"approved\", contains the exact approved sentence with 90% and 7 天. Add a contract-level check that the rendered day count equals POST_COMPLETION_ORDER_WINDOW_MS / 86_400_000 and the rendered percent equals COMPLETION_PERCENT."},{"file":"src/app/(app)/lives/[id]/analytics/page.tsx","area":"copy accuracy","severity":"low","confidence":0.55,"issue":"The rule says \"同一影片實際看過的不重複區間達 90%\" without naming the per-viewer scope. The contract requires same-person, same-session/content-version facts. A reader could take the rule as coverage pooled across all viewers.","evidence":"Copy: \"同一影片實際看過的不重複區間達 {COMPLETION_PERCENT}% 才算完看\". Contract: \"Callers must supply verified, same-person, same-tenant, same-session/content-version facts\".","impact":"Vendors may misread what counts as a completed viewing, so the stated rule is ambiguous even though the metrics remain unavailable.","recommended_fix":"Reword to \"同一位觀眾在同一影片實際看過的不重複區間達 90% 才算完看\", and optionally add \"同一位觀眾\" to the order clause (\"該觀眾於首次完看後 7 天內...\").","required_test":"Assert the rule paragraph contains \"同一位觀眾\" or \"每位觀眾\" next to the 90% completion rule."},{"file":"src/app/(app)/lives/[id]/analytics/page.tsx","area":"copy consistency","severity":"low","confidence":0.5,"issue":"The unchanged lead sentence \"資料與統計口徑就緒後才會顯示數值。\" now sits directly above a paragraph that presents the statistical rule as approved and final. The two read inconsistently, because 口徑 is no longer the pending piece for completion and post-completion orders. The \"統計規則\" label is also unqualified, although it covers only 完看率 and 看完下單率, not 報名率, 到場率, or 平均觀看時長.","evidence":"Context lines: `

資料與統計口徑就緒後才會顯示數值。

` followed by `

統計規則：...`. The rule text mentions only completion and post-completion orders.","impact":"Minor user confusion about whether the rule is final and whether it applies to all five cards. This is not a calculation or claim error.","recommended_fix":"Change the lead to \"資料就緒後才會顯示數值。\", or clarify that only the 口徑 for other metrics is pending. Retitle the rule line to \"完看率與看完下單率統計規則：\".","required_test":"Update the page snapshot or text assertion to the chosen wording and confirm the five cards still show \"尚不可計算\"."}]}
